intro.summary: St Luke the Evangelist, companion of St Paul and author of the Gospel of Luke and Acts, is honored for proclaiming Christ through Scripture.

blocks.text: You can pray the full St Luke Novena below.
blocks.title: Introduction

blocks.notes: expanded canonical prayer references into full rosary texts; converted "mention request here" into a personal-intention pause marker; reused compacted prayer source from an earlier section; converted intention marker into sacred bell and personal-intention pause

parts.text: In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. Most charming and saintly Physician, you were animated by the heavenly Spirit of Love. In faithfully describing the humanity of Our Lord Jesus Christ, you also showed His divinity and His genuine compassion for all human beings. Inspire me and those I pray for with your professionalism and with the divine compassion for those we serve. Remember especially my intention in this novena

May the Holy Spirit help me to understand Christ’s words and faithfully apply them in my life. Amen. Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come, thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen. Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Saint Luke the Evangelist, pray for us! In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
